scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1] / [LTIM.1.3.1]: a product or quotient of a `Duration` and a negative `Int` is `0_s`. One S, `n` -3 and `d` 2 s. Rules `left` (`s.n * s.d == 0_s`), `right` (`s.d * s.n == 0_s`) and `quotient` (`s.d / s.n == 0_s`) fire; rule `negative` (`s.n * s.d < 0_s`) would fire on the unsaturated -6 s and must not. Rule `third` logs `(s.d / 3)::String`: `Duration / Int` is integer division of nanoseconds ([LTIM.4.1.1]), so it is `666ms666us666ns`, where a `Float` quotient ([LEXP.7.4]) could not be cast. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `rlow_6_1_6_saturating` lowering `n * dur` and `dur * n` to `FN_MAX(op_mul, 0)` and `dur / n` to `FN_MAX(op_floordiv, 0)` ([RLOW.6.1.6]).
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    id: Int key
    n: Int mutable
    d: Duration mutable

rule left:
    S s where s.n * s.d == 0_s
->
    log info "left"

rule right:
    S s where s.d * s.n == 0_s
->
    log info "right"

rule quotient:
    S s where s.d / s.n == 0_s
->
    log info "quotient"

rule negative:
    S s where s.n * s.d < 0_s
->
    log info "negative"

rule third:
    S s
->
    let t = (s.d / 3)::String
    log info "third {t}"
